description: Source code for the ContentWriter class in the PDFsharp library, responsible for writing PDF content streams.

classes.name: ContentWriter
classes.description: A class for generating PDF streams by writing raw data, managing indentation, and handling stream operations.

methods.name: ContentWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the writer with a content stream.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a boolean value to the stream (implementation commented out).

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes a raw string to the stream as bytes.

methods.name: WriteLineRaw
methods.description: Writes a raw string followed by a newline to the stream.

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes a single character as a byte to the stream.

methods.name: Indent
methods.description: Gets or sets the indentation level for writing.

methods.name: IndentBlanks
methods.description: Returns a string of spaces corresponding to the current indentation.

methods.name: WriteIndent
methods.description: Writes the current indentation to the stream.

methods.name: WriteSeparator
methods.description: Handles writing separators based on character category.

methods.name: GetCategory
methods.description: Determines the category of a character (character, delimiter, newline).
